api · just now
Found the login bug. Sessions ended after five
minutes because the cookie's lifetime was set
in seconds where the code meant minutes.
It's 30 days now, as the docs say, and a new
test signs in, waits past the old limit and
checks you're still signed in.
All 182 tests pass. Nothing is committed yet:

the change is two lines in auth/session.go and
the test.
